decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX trommel screen grew out of the established BASIC 518, sits in Doppstadt's core mobile screening segment and was actively developed further, so dropping it is unlikely.
The AK flail shredder series is a long-standing core mobile line that was recently upgraded to EU Stage V engines, which signals continued investment.
The mobile high-speed grinder line moved to its own page in 2019 and fits the firm's mobile processing focus, even though the related green-waste grinder variant was consolidated away.

The stationary CERON pre-shredders are promoted as a new benchmark generation with reference installations, but stationary products are peripheral to the mobile core and one stationary shredder was already removed, so the risk of dropping is moderate.
